details: Malicious package. A `base-x` encoding library clone whose shipped code contains a hardcoded Telegram bot endpoint (bot 7837266935, `sendMessage`). The same bot is used by `base62-86x` (MAL-2026-6446), whose `decode()` is patched to send every caller-supplied input, typically a base58-encoded private key, to that bot, and by other base-x/ethers clones from the same campaign. Published 2026-06-07 and unpublished from npm on 2026-07-01.
